stories.title: What Winnipeg can learn from Toronto’s housing model
stories.summary: A new mental health and addictions hospital and housing units will be built in Winnipeg replicating a housing project based in Toronto.

stories.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers quarterback Zach Collaros putting off retirement decision for now
stories.summary: Quarterback Zach Collaros got teary when speaking about what could come next at the team's end-of-season availabilities on Sunday.

stories.title: Jets coach Arniel disappointed Hellebuyck won’t face former team in Winnipeg
stories.summary: Connor Hellebuyck will attempt to explain himself when he gets to Winnipeg. What the star goaltender won't be doing is suiting up to face his former team.

stories.title: Hellebuyck, Meier lead Devils past Maple Leafs 4-0
stories.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 23 saves for his first shutout with New Jersey as the Devils blanked the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-0 on Sunday night.

stories.title: Alouettes advance to Grey Cup with East final win
stories.summary: Davis Alexander led his team back to the Grey Cup.

stories.title: Carney says co-ordination, dedication, funding all needed to end homelessness
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney says the federal government has learned from past mistakes as it sets out its ambitious aim of eliminating homelessness within 10 years.

stories.title: Alouettes are ready for East final against Winnipeg Blue Bombers – no matter who starts at QB
stories.summary: Bombers quarterback Zach Collaros is a game-time decision for Saturday's Eastern Final against the Alouettes.

stories.title: Woman charged after man found dead by police responding to domestic call: WPS
stories.summary: Winnipeg police arrested a 28-year-old woman in connection with the death of Kyle Aaron Woodhouse, 32, the service said in a news release.

stories.title: 5 charged with manslaughter after death of 23-year-old in Winnipeg
stories.summary: Two adults and three teens were charged with manslaughter in connection with the death of Jayden Laporte, a member of Long Plain First Nation who lived in Portage la Prairie.

stories.title: Disbarred former Manitoba law dean loses extradition fight in French Appeal Court
stories.summary: A document from the Versailles Court of Appeal says the Indictment Division has granted Canada's request to extradite the man. No transfer date was given.
